nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I have a feeling she'll be delayed by... Unforeseen circumstances.
Wes shoots $ZOE a quick wink before closing up another locker and disappearing around the corner.
$ZOE returns to the table as Emily and Kimi are talking...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Cough! Cough!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough! Cough![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So what's the story with you and Kevin? Is that happening?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I think I can sum it up for you... For the Spring Break Robo-Con, I'll be riding up to the convention center in his van with him!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: And, if that weren't enough, the convention center is located in a hotel that overlooks Centerscore Beach!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, that all sounds serious!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That's what I thought... Until I realized that he also offered rides to the entire Robotics Club!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm... Confused again.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Story of my life, Em. Story of my life.
$ZOE sits down.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Where'd you go off to, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't worry about that... I think I figured out how to get you to see Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `And` I've got a task we really need you for, Kimi!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]And[/i][/color] I've got a task we really need you for, Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? What is it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it has to happen tonight!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Seriously. I'm not even going, but if I don't get details `now,` I will `walk` out of here on my broken leg!
nodes.text_bbcode: Seriously. I'm not even going, but if I don't get details [color=#e23b3b][i]now,[/i][/color] I will [color=#e23b3b][i]walk[/i][/color] out of here on my broken leg!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, right, sorry...
$ZOE leans in and tells the group her plan...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I understand how much that might appeal to you. Meet a new person, share some pastries, make a friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That sounds great! I'm good at all those things!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: But you don't have time for courtship! The meeting takes place at 6:00 tonight!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... Well, what are we supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `Impersonate Abigail.` You're not really good at this kind of thinking, are you?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Impersonate Abigail.[/i][/color] You're not really good at this kind of thinking, are you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I didn't consider it because it seems wrong...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Morally questionable, yes. Then again, how guilty are you feeling?
$ZOE mulls this over for a moment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, so, how does this work? If she's going to be there at 6:00, what good will it do to impersonate her?
Wes smiles.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Didn't know you had this shady kind of thinking in you...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm full of surprises.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Abigail and Whitford are supposed to meet at Monarch Prep at 6:00 tonight. Hope you come prepared.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... What about Abigail?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Still, you'd have to be `pretty` desperate to go further into debt with me.
nodes.text_bbcode: Still, you'd have to be [color=#e23b3b][i]pretty[/i][/color] desperate to go further into debt with me.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's no other way we could get the code.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Because there's no other factor at play here? Nothing you feel guilty about?
Wes bangs open another locker. $ZOE can't hide her feelings.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay, fine! Paige might have seen us kiss! And if I'm the one who drives the two of them apart...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I couldn't handle that...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Very well. In order to disable Monarch Prep's alarm system, you have to know the 5-digit keycode.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: For tonight only, that keycode is `88775.` After tonight, the code changes, and then I can't help you.
nodes.text_bbcode: For tonight only, that keycode is [color=#e23b3b][i]88775.[/i][/color] After tonight, the code changes, and then I can't help you.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Where's the keypad?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's where things get mighty tricky. It's at the heart of a security center that Principal Whitford guards like a hawk's mother.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do we get past her?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: `That` was not part of our deal.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]That[/i][/color] was not part of our deal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's it?! That's all you're giving me?! A five-digit code that expires in a few `hours?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: That's it?! That's all you're giving me?! A five-digit code that expires in a few [color=#3b78e2][i]hours?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's all you `asked` for.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's all you [color=#e23b3b][i]asked[/i][/color] for.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, what about schematics or spy equipment or a device that turns off all the power for a whole city block?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: An EMP bomb? You know I'm a high school student, not a military organization, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine... I guess I was just... Hoping for something more.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Okay, look, you were honest with me about Owen, and I feel `almost` bad about tricking you for information on Autumn and Lindsay...
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, look, you were honest with me about Owen, and I feel [color=#e23b3b][i]almost[/i][/color] bad about tricking you for information on Autumn and Lindsay...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Glad my gullibility generated a near-emotion in you.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: A young girl named Abigail Weatherfrost who is interested in attending Monarch Prep is scheduled to meet with Principal Whitford in a few hours.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who would be crazy enough to `want` to go there?
nodes.text_bbcode: Who would be crazy enough to [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to go there?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Someone who doesn't know how much it's changed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So? How can she help us?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: She's all kinds of rich. Given the school's current economic status, Whitford might actually jump through hoops to get on this girl's good side.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're thinking...

options.label: We recruit her for our team!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Are you sure?
$ZOE remembers all the time she's spent with Owen...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He was there for me when I was trying to become Social Chair...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And I was there for him when he was trying to get a new start...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We've been through `so` much together!
nodes.text_bbcode: We've been through [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] much together!

nodes.text: She looks at Wes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How could I not have feelings for him after all this?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That's something I don't know. After all, it's `your` heart.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's something I don't know. After all, it's [color=#e23b3b][i]your[/i][/color] heart.

nodes.text: Somewhere in $ZOE, she can feel that she's lying to herself.
She knows it's time to move on...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Friends?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I used to have feelings for him, but not anymore. Owen and I aren't really meant for each other.
Wes nods.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: So, you're helping Owen out of friendship? Out of the kindness of your marshmallow-soft heart?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's right.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, it doesn't even matter, Kimi, because there's still Whitford... And the alarm system...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I want this to work, but it seems like it'll just be a waste of everyone's time.
From her vantage point, $ZOE can see Wes out in the hallway...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I just had an idea... Wait here, guys, I'll be right back!
You are now playing as $ZOE...
$ZOE approaches Wes as he fiddles with the combination to a locker.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Wes...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: One second. Almost...
He spins the lock!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: ...Got it!
He pops the locker open, quickly takes out a bright pink notebook, and closes the locker up.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That notebook says 'Katie' on it! Is it yours?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Per our last conversation, it's probably best if you don't ask any questions.
Sidestepping casually, he bangs twice on another locker, and it opens right up.
Without hesitation, he deposits the bright pink notebook while simultaneously extracting a paper bag.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: We can walk and talk here while I conduct business.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, um... I need your help. Again.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Otherwise, why would you be talking to me, right?
Another locker pops open, and Wes stuffs a roll of ten dollar bills inside.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You didn't see anything, right?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Right.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I need to know how to disable the alarm system for the Monarch Prep Detention Center.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: An expensive and difficult request. But since I like you so much, I'll offer you another deal.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Gee, thanks. What's the cost? Just my soul this time?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Slightly less steep: one more favor, plus information.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: I want to know who you think the next Head Cheerleader is going to be...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is this about getting revenge on Lindsay for destroying Autumn's camera?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Questions. Questions. Questions.
Wes moves down and enters the combination for another locker.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Oops! This one's yours!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Sorry... While it's open, you need anything?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No! Stay out of there!
Wes closes it, a delighted smile on his face.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. If I `had` to guess, and it would be a total guess, I'd say the next Head Cheerleader will be Lindsay.
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. If I [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to guess, and it would be a total guess, I'd say the next Head Cheerleader will be Lindsay.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She's the most like all the former Head Cheerleaders... Paula, Taylor, and Jessica.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Does this mean we have a deal?
He extends a hand. $ZOE sighs, looking back at Owen in the cafeteria... Then, she shakes Wes's hand.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Deal. A favor to be named later...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Plus?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus?!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Information, as discussed.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I just `gave` you information!
nodes.text_bbcode: But I just [color=#3b78e2][i]gave[/i][/color] you information!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Exactly. You `gave` it to me. Which I appreciated.
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly. You [color=#e23b3b][i]gave[/i][/color] it to me. Which I appreciated.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You snake! You tricked me!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Guilty as charged. Do we have a deal or not?
$ZOE grits her teeth.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine. Information. But nothing `too` personal or creepy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine. Information. But nothing [color=#3b78e2][i]too[/i][/color] personal or creepy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm not going to give you details about the girls' locker room!

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: What you must think of me... Anyway... Information first.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: You're asking me to disable the alarm system so Owen can go see Paige. I'm assuming, but I always assume correctly.

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: That basically means that once again you're helping Owen get closer to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you want to know?

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Do you still have feelings for him?
$ZOE thinks about her stage-kiss with Owen, how the only way she could make it feel passionate was by thinking of Howard...

nodes.speaker: Wes
nodes.text: Well?

nodes.prompt: Do you still have feelings for Owen?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Do you still have feelings for Owen?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yet? Like I'm going to be hanging around you `more?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yet? Like I'm going to be hanging around you [color=#3b78e2][i]more?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... If you want?
Emily nudges Kimi.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Easy there, stalker.
Kimi takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I mean, you're `so` right. You just don't know my repertoire of skills!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, you're [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] right. You just don't know my repertoire of skills!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Well, `I` do! Fashion, singing, and you're pretty handy with computers!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] do! Fashion, singing, and you're pretty handy with computers!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: All perfect for a heist...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, I'm just impressed that you used the word repertoire!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, we just established that, didn't we?

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Owen, you're a football and basketball stud.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Ben, you're like this nerd, jock, `everything!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ben, you're like this nerd, jock, [color=#3b78e2][i]everything![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Emily, you're a swimming goddess!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're like Miss Perfect! And I don't mean that as an insult! It's true!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So that just leaves me... The `nothing.`
nodes.text_bbcode: So that just leaves me... The [color=#3b78e2][i]nothing.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Hey, that's not true.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Well, you can act, right?
Both $ZOE and Emily shake their heads furiously at Owen, but it's too late!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah, as The Nurse! What a great role in `Romeo and Juliet!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, as The Nurse! What a great role in [color=#3b78e2][i]Romeo and Juliet![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh... I'll just move on...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Good call, dude.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So, we're helping you. What's the plan?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I'm not sure yet. Monarch Prep is a total fortress. I just know we have to figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I would give `anything` just to see Paige... Just to be sure she's okay...
nodes.text_bbcode: I would give [color=#e23b3b][i]anything[/i][/color] just to see Paige... Just to be sure she's okay...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Awwwwwww!
The four at the Center Table turn to see Kimi gazing at Owen from a nearby table. She stiffens!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I said that out loud, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: What are you doing? Come over here, Kimi!
Kimi takes a seat at the Center Table.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I didn't realize I was worthy enough to sit with you guys!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: We're assuming you're good for the $10 entry fee.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... What?
Emily whacks Ben!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Don't try to take advantage of my friends!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: That $10 was going toward your birthday present... But I guess now you're getting some socks.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry for eavesdropping, guys.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Can I just tell you something, Owen? I know `way` more than I should about you and Paige!
nodes.text_bbcode: Can I just tell you something, Owen? I know [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] more than I should about you and Paige!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've loved you guys ever since that psych project report you gave!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Plus, I totally squealed when I heard how you went on a Valentine's `outing` together!
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, I totally squealed when I heard how you went on a Valentine's [color=#3b78e2][i]outing[/i][/color] together!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: How did you know about our Valentine's Day? And you're a freshman! You're not even in Psych!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Er... Never mind, never mind! You were saying something about a fortress!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: So, first, there's a security guard who patrols the Monarch Prep grounds...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: He's like a cross between a giant and a ninja because he's everywhere at once.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does anyone else want to see `Ninja Giant` turned into a movie?
nodes.text_bbcode: Does anyone else want to see [color=#e23b3b][i]Ninja Giant[/i][/color] turned into a movie?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Even if you're lucky enough to avoid detection from him, there's still Principal Whitford herself, who guards the main entrance...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: She's old and out-of-touch, but she's pretty skilled with a broom.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm sorry... Did you say 'broom'? You're afraid of an old woman with a broom?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, it's all fun and games till she starts sweeping at your face!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Anyway, even if you manage to avoid her, there's still the fact that the whole complex is rigged with alarms!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Once they go off, the spotlights find you, and that means the giant and the broom aren't far behind...

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Does anyone feel like we just entered a wacky children's book? Anyone?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, there's no reason to despair! We can totally help!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah! It'll be just like those heist movies!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Wait... I'm assuming I can come along.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course you can! All of us bring something to the table! I'll be the driver!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And Emily, you've got that whole athleticism thing going!
Emily nods, coughing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: `Cough!` I'll be fine. My doctor says I'm just not supposed to talk much.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Cough![/i][/color] I'll be fine. My doctor says I'm just not supposed to talk much.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I can totally set up one of my patented Ben pranks! All I'll need is--
Ben excitedly twists in his wheelchair.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! My leg! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Guess who's going to be resting instead of coming with us?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Aww, man. I'm the one who stays back and hopes nothing goes wrong?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I know you want to help, sweetie.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Hey, I'll be the best guy who stays back `ever.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Hey, I'll be the best guy who stays back [color=#e23b3b][i]ever.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily kisses Ben's head.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: That's my boyfriend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Anyway, Owen, you can use your knowledge of the campus to find Paige! And Kimi...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Well, you can... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I can't really do anything, can I?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's not true, Kimi.

options.label: We just don't know you well enough yet!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige is `my`... Friend. She's not really any of yours.
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is [color=#e23b3b][i]my[/i][/color]... Friend. She's not really any of yours.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, but we're `your` friends! And when your friend needs something, you help them!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, but we're [color=#3b78e2][i]your[/i][/color] friends! And when your friend needs something, you help them!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't ask you to do that, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, we're not going to just sit around while you struggle over this!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Besides, haven't you already tried to break into Monarch Prep a bunch of times on your own?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: At least a half dozen times.

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: So... It'd be pretty dumb to try again by yourself then, wouldn't it?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I guess so.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Looks like you just got logic-crushed `by girls--`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ha ha ha! Looks like you just got logic-crushed [color=#e23b3b][i]by girls--[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Emily twists Ben's wheelchair just a notch, causing his broken leg to bend a hair.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Which is... `Ow...` Not at all unusual in these enlightened, modern times!
nodes.text_bbcode: Which is... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow...[/i][/color] Not at all unusual in these enlightened, modern times!

nodes.text: Emily puts the chair back.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I've tried to break into that place a bunch of times on my own, but most of my attempts failed pretty miserably.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Frankly, I could use the help!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, help is here!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You sure? I mean, I know how most of you feel about Paige.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Feelings aside, we all want `you` to be happy, Owen...
nodes.text_bbcode: Feelings aside, we all want [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] to be happy, Owen...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I second that.
Ben raises a hand.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I third it. Can you third something? Because that's what I'm doing.

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Say, is it getting hot in here? Or is that just my malfunctioning fan?

nodes.speaker: LYLE
nodes.text: Get it? Because that was not a joke.

nodes.speaker: Kevin
nodes.text: L.Y.L.E. says that when its internal temperature rises...

nodes.speaker: Kimi

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: But I don't think I can handle being an... I don't want to say `invalid,` but...
nodes.text_bbcode: But I don't think I can handle being an... I don't want to say [color=#e23b3b][i]invalid,[/i][/color] but...

nodes.text: Oh yeah, should you be talking?

nodes.speaker: Emily

Emily stops the wheelchair.

nodes.text: Did you hear something?

nodes.speaker: Ben

`FWOOM!`

Dex and Kimi try to hide their snickers.

nodes.text: A light tapping on the open security room door breaks Kimi's concentration.
Both she and Whitford turn to see a well-to-do young lady standing in the doorway.

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: Hullo. I'm Abigail Weatherfrost. I've an appointment this evening.

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: I was calling from out there, but I don't think anyone heard me over the sound of the alarm. Is everything all right?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What did you say your name was?!

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: Abigail Weatherfrost. I'm sorry for being so late. It's just that all the power in our home went off and then none of our cars would start.

nodes.speaker: Abigail
nodes.text: Terrible bother flagging down a limo at this hour.
Principal Whitford pushes Kimi aside, staring at the console, taking in the disabled security system...
And then Owen, traversing the dorm building!
She whirls on Kimi!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You!
Whitford grabs Kimi, hauling her past the real Abigail and out of the security room!
As they pass the PA system, Whitford grabs it and hails Brock!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Sorry, Owen! I did the best I could...
You are now playing as Owen...
Balanced on a ledge of the dorm building, Owen inches toward the last window...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: This is it. If she's not in this room, she's not here!
He peeks in. Sitting on the bed, talking to a redhead, is Paige!
Owen's heart feels like it's exploding in his chest!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I can't believe it! I'm actually about to talk to her!
He tries to pry open the window, but he can only open it a smidge, just enough to hear the girls talking!
Their voices are almost drowned out by music coming from a stereo system.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? Jessica doesn't stand a chance.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But she's `so` manipulative.
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] manipulative.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't think I can get more cute, rich boys than her?!
Owen pauses, shocked for just a second.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Cute, rich boys?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll give you that she's manipulative, but she's not even that rich.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: If you beat her, Whitford will totally let you go to the Debutante Dance for Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's... Great news.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The hotel overlooks Centerscore Beach!
Owen is just about to call out to Paige when...

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock. Catch. Boy!
Brock manages to grab Owen's leg and pull him down from the building!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: `Whoa!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Whoa![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A moment later, Whitford watches as Brock tosses Owen and Kimi off of the Monarch Prep grounds!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: If I see either of you again, I won't give you the luxury of being thrown out! Instead, I'll call the police!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And I'll make sure you end up in jail! Do you understand me?
Owen gets up and pulls Kimi to her feet.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: We get it. Don't worry... We won't be back.
Owen and Kimi walk away from the grounds and out onto the street toward their rendezvous point with $ZOE and Emily.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Owen... I tried to buy you as much time as I could... Did you get to see Paige?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I did. But not for very long.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I guess you didn't get to say what you wanted?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I didn't get to say `anything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I didn't get to say [color=#e23b3b][i]anything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: But I did overhear something!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I know where Paige is going to be for Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What? Where?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: A hotel near Centerscore Beach! And I'm going to be there too!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Really? Eeep! So... That means...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That means the mission was a success! I couldn't thank you enough, Kimi!
Kimi beams.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It was... Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You don't have to be modest.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Okay, it was awesome! `I` was awesome! It was like the greatest performance I've ever given in my life!
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, it was awesome! [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] was awesome! It was like the greatest performance I've ever given in my life!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Only no one was there to see it...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hey, I might not have been there, but you were a pretty important piece in getting that information.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Yeah. So seriously... Thank you!
Owen gives Kimi a big hug!
A moment later, Owen and Kimi are riding back home in $ZOE's car...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: So then Whitford was all, like, 'How do you know this building is the security building?!'

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! What'd you do?!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't even remember! But whatever I did, I got in!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: What'd you think of the guard, Emily?

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Oh, yeah! Thanks for telling me he runs faster than a nervous gazelle!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Hahaha!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I was so freaked out when I first saw how big he was... I'm just glad I remembered not to step on the grass!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You won't even believe what I had to deal with...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This elderly lady just `had` to be in the middle of the road `right` when Emily needed me most!
nodes.text_bbcode: This elderly lady just [color=#3b78e2][i]had[/i][/color] to be in the middle of the road [color=#3b78e2][i]right[/i][/color] when Emily needed me most!

nodes.text: As the group laughs and shares their moments...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I just want to say, 'thank you.' I couldn't have done this without your help.
The girls let out a collective `Awwww!` as the car heads closer and closer to home.
nodes.text_bbcode: The girls let out a collective [b]Awwww![/b] as the car heads closer and closer to home.

nodes.text: All Owen can think about is that he's one step closer to Paige...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: All I have to do now is find her during Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Exactly` as I suspected!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Exactly[/i][/color] as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not what you think, I have amnesia or something, and I--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Exactly` as I suspected!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Exactly[/i][/color] as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not what you think, I have amnesia or something, and I--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you accusing me of something?!
The suspicious look fades from Whitford's face and is immediately replaced with regret...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm... I'm so sorry, dear. I thought that with this curfew violation and your behavior...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, it's been a rough evening! Please forgive me!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I'll consider it, especially if you consider grabbing a bite somewhere nearby.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I... I would.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are there any local eateries that cater to my sophisticated palate?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well...
As Whitford struggles to list restaurants in the surrounding area, Kimi silently praises herself.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Way to stall, Kimi Chen!
Finally, Whitford runs out of breath.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: That last one sounds permissible. I'm sure you have a driver for just such an--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Exactly` as I suspected!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Exactly[/i][/color] as I suspected!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It's not what you think, I have amnesia or something, and I--

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh...
Kimi says the first thing that comes to mind!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eunice Hogbottom!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I don't have much time!
Kimi flips open a panel and stares at the keypad.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: What was the code?!
Kimi enters the code into the keypad, but the light for the dorm building alarm doesn't go out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Um... Hello? I `thought` that's what it was...
nodes.text_bbcode: Um... Hello? I [color=#3b78e2][i]thought[/i][/color] that's what it was...

nodes.text: She tries again, but it doesn't work!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Are you serious?! No, I did `not` forget the password!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you serious?! No, I did [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] forget the password!

nodes.text: She holds her hands against her temples!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `What` is it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]What[/i][/color] is it?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The password is 88775.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Thanks, I...
Kimi looks over and sees Whitford standing there menacingly, broom in hand and a loathing scowl on her face.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You'd better come with me, impostor!
Kimi sighs.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am...
As Whitford roughly escorts Kimi out of the building, she knows without a doubt that...
Kimi enters the code. A second later, the light for the dorm building alarm goes out!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Yes!
As Kimi heads out of the room, she takes out her phone and types out a text to Owen!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Eeeep! It's like I'm helping my two favorites characters in a story get together!
Whitford blocks the doorway just as Kimi hits 'Send' on her phone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You brought up a good point about further escapes... If you don't mind, I'd like to continue our interview in here, where I can keep my eye on `everything.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You brought up a good point about further escapes... If you don't mind, I'd like to continue our interview in here, where I can keep my eye on [color=#3b78e2][i]everything.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Uh, sure.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I've gotta stall! Whitford's going to see Owen on the monitors at any moment!
Near the dorm building, Owen's phone beeps quietly in his hideout spot deep within the bushes.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hope there's good news in this text, Kimi...
He looks at it.

nodes.speaker: Phone
nodes.text: scrty dis8bld! go 4 it! p.s. i think u n paige r sooooooooo cute!!!!1!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Why do I suddenly feel like I have a fan club?!
Owen emerges from the bushes and approaches the corner of the dorm building. He reaches his hand out... And touches it!
`Silence.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Silence.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Nice job, angels!
Owen shimmies up the corner of the building, using a column to assist his climb to the second floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Paige's room has got to be here somewhere!
He shimmies along a narrow ledge on the second floor.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Don't look down!
In the first window, a girl sings a sad song by herself.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: { Nobody knows... The trouble I see! {

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: That's sad...
He keeps moving along the ledge...
In the next window, a crying girl is comforted by another!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It's going to be okay, Caroline! This place is hard on all of us! You'll see your family soon...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: But I miss my yacht, too!
A sudden gust of wind nearly knocks Owen over! But he manages to hang on!
He looks up along the row of windows and realizes...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: There must be thirty more rooms!
Owen starts shimmying along the ledge as fast as he can!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: I hope you can stall Whitford just a little bit more, Kimi!
Meanwhile, back in the security room, Kimi's attempts to stall Whitford are wearing thin!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: `O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]O, Romeo, Romeo... Wherefore art thou, Romeo? Deny thy father and refuse thy name...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I appreciate the arts as much as the next headmaster, but you'll have to forgive me!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I am not in the mood to hear every line from Romeo and Juliet at the moment!
Whitford gets up from the chair Kimi has placed her in! Kimi leaps in her way, blocking her view of the video monitor!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: You're not feeling a bit peckish, are you? I could really go for a Cowboy Burger.
A look of suspicion comes over Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Shoot! Rich people don't go to Cowboy Burger!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Tell me... What was your name again? It's so interesting.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: My name? You mean...

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I do what `I` want!
nodes.text_bbcode: I do what [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] want!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why are you so insistent on remaining in this room?
Whitford's eyebrow raises.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: There's something peculiar about you!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Oh no!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: It must be my family's natural charisma shining through me! You do remember that my family's rich, don't you?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes... Something you seem to be reminding me of often.

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Too much, Kimi!
The sound of the alarm grabs Whitford's attention!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Fine! Have it your way! But I `will` be back soon!
nodes.text_bbcode: Fine! Have it your way! But I [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] be back soon!

nodes.text: She angrily storms out! Kimi can hear her on a PA system in the next room, hailing Brock.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: I want to be in the safest place possible! Who knows how many others are planning to get in or out?!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A `fair` point, I guess... You may stay here. Don't touch anything!
nodes.text_bbcode: A [color=#3b78e2][i]fair[/i][/color] point, I guess... You may stay here. Don't touch anything!

nodes.text: Whitford leaves in a rush! Kimi can hear her on a PA system in the next room, hailing Brock.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No! It's merely a small matter of funding! You saw how my guard nearly caught her!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Imagine if a dozen guards patrolled the grounds!

nodes.speaker: Kimi
nodes.text: Nice job, girls!
Kimi wipes away her smile and turns to Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! Are you okay?! You look awful!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: I'm `never` doing this again. Just drive.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]never[/i][/color] doing this again. Just drive.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well, Kimi has to be doing better than us, right?
When $ZOE reaches the west wall, Emily peeks out from behind a nearby bush and hops into the car!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, I'm late, you wouldn't believe--

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Go go go! He could be anywhere!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who?!
All of a sudden, Brock leaps onto the hood of $ZOE's car!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Brock!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `AHHHHHHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]AHHHHHHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.text: $ZOE swerves, managing to toss Brock off the hood of her car but not before plowing into a mailbox!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: My car!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Your car? What about me? I was in that bush for `way` too long!
nodes.text_bbcode: Your car? What about me? I was in that bush for [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] too long!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm `so` sorry, Em!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] sorry, Em!

nodes.text: $ZOE throws the car into reverse and heads away...
As $ZOE speeds off, she gives Emily a quick glance.
$ZOE hits the brakes, her car screeching to a halt a few yards from the crosswalk.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: She can't take `that` long, right?
nodes.text_bbcode: She can't take [color=#3b78e2][i]that[/i][/color] long, right?

nodes.text: What seems like a hundred hours later...
At last, the lady scoots out of the way.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Finally...
$ZOE accelerates through the crosswalk...
$ZOE slams on the brakes, scrambles out of her car, and helps the elderly lady.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hi, ma'am! Let me help you!
$ZOE extends an arm for the lady, who takes it.

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Why, thank you! You sure are a nice one!
$ZOE picks up the pace.

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Whoo! Skedad! I haven't moved this fast since the East Humble County Pickle Race!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's nice!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Of course they weren't called pickles then! Back then, they were brine sausages!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh huh.
$ZOE moves just a little bit faster!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: Then these slick, marketing, Uncle Sam types came in and tried to put the wool-eye on all of us!
The lady tries to demonstrate to $ZOE what 'the wool-eye' looks like.
They reach the far curb!

nodes.speaker: Elderly Lady
nodes.text: You remember what we talked about!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I will! Pickles! Brine sausages!
$ZOE races back to her car, hops in, and speeds off!
A split-second later, $ZOE reaches the west wall!
Emily manages to leap over just as a gargantuan hand reaches out to try to grab her, barely missing!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That was close!
Emily jumps into the car, and they speed off!

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Nice timing!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks!
$ZOE accelerates past the elderly lady, calling out of her window!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry for cutting you off! I have to help a friend!
A second later, police lights flash in her rearview mirror!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh no!
$ZOE pulls over and stops. Officer Monte gets out of his car and barrels over to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Disgusting! I've seen some shameful acts in my time as a superior enforcer of the law, but I have never `ever` seen something so disgraceful!
nodes.text_bbcode: Disgusting! I've seen some shameful acts in my time as a superior enforcer of the law, but I have never [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] seen something so disgraceful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't--

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Do `not` interrupt me, missy! I know what I saw! A blatant disregard for the infirm!
nodes.text_bbcode: Do [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] interrupt me, missy! I know what I saw! A blatant disregard for the infirm!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Plus, let's not forget how you belligerized the victim as you passed her in your vehicle!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Belligerized isn't a word!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Your talk-backity attitude is noted! I suggest you remain `silent.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Your talk-backity attitude is noted! I suggest you remain [color=#e23b3b][i]silent.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Em...
$ZOE keeps her mouth shut as Monte writes her up a ticket.
A few minutes later, $ZOE finally drives away from the intersection...

nodes.speaker: Emily
nodes.text: Come `on!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Come [color=#3b78e2][i]on![/i][/color]

nodes.text: A sign along a fence in front of the wall reads `'ELECTRIFIED FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE'.`
nodes.text_bbcode: A sign along a fence in front of the wall reads [b]'ELECTRIFIED FOR YOUR CONVENIENCE'.[/b]

nodes.text: Distracted, Emily doesn't realize how close behind Brock is!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Got... You!
Brock lunges for Emily! She ducks under his massive arms, and his momentum carries him past her, nearly into the fence!

nodes.text: Let's not get too cocky, fellas! After all, if you fly too close to the sun, you'll burn your hot dog buns!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Th-th-that explains everything!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I'll be in the nurse's office, boys! Let me know how it goes!

nodes.text: Sure!

nodes.text: Thanks for letting me be a part of--
